# hazwoperosha.org

> HAZWOPER OSHA Compliance Library is a free educational resource hub covering HAZWOPER (29 CFR 1910.120) training requirements: 40-hour, 24-hour, 8-hour annual refresher, supervisor, and emergency response/incident command tracks. It includes an interactive compliance finder, an employer toolkit (training matrix, refresher tracker, onboarding and site-specific checklists, emergency response readiness checklist), a federal-vs-state OSHA guide (including Cal/OSHA), and a Spanish-language resources hub.

HAZWOPER OSHA Compliance Library is a privately operated educational companion site to HAZWOPER-OSHA.com (an IACET-accredited training provider and subsidiary of Industrial Certified Training, LLC) and is not affiliated with OSHA, the U.S. Department of Labor, or any government agency. All course enrollment, pricing, group/SCORM/LMS requests, and purchases are handled on hazwoper-osha.com; this site does not sell courses directly.

## Pages

- [Home / Compliance Finder](https://hazwoperosha.org/): Interactive finder mapping a worker's situation (cleanup site, emergency response, TSDF, occasional site worker, supervisor, or annual refresher) to the HAZWOPER training track that commonly applies, with direct links to the matching course on hazwoper-osha.com.
- [Course Catalog Search](https://hazwoperosha.org/courses/): Searchable/filterable tool over HAZWOPER OSHA Training's full course catalog — 1,000+ courses and 80 bundles across 59 categories and 20 industries. Filter by category or industry, search by name/regulation/tag, switch between list and grid views, and view course/bundle detail. Pricing is intentionally not shown publicly; results link to the course's live hazwoper-osha.com page where available, otherwise to a training-advisor contact CTA.
- [HAZWOPER Explained](https://hazwoperosha.org/hazwoper-explained/): Plain-language guide to 40-hour, 24-hour, 8-hour refresher, supervisor, and incident command HAZWOPER training under 29 CFR 1910.120, including a side-by-side comparison table and "who needs this" breakdown.
- [Employer Toolkit](https://hazwoperosha.org/employer-toolkit/): Five printable reference resources — HAZWOPER training matrix, annual refresher tracker, new employee safety onboarding checklist, site-specific training checklist, and emergency response readiness checklist.
- [State OSHA Guide](https://hazwoperosha.org/state-osha-guide/): How federal OSHA and state-plan states differ on HAZWOPER training, a Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER spotlight, and a reference list of full-plan, public-sector-only, and federal-OSHA states.
- [Spanish Resources](https://hazwoperosha.org/spanish-resources/): Bilingual (English/Spanish) hub explaining HAZWOPER basics and pointing to bilingual course options on hazwoper-osha.com.
- [FAQ](https://hazwoperosha.org/frequently-asked-questions/): Answers on HAZWOPER basics, training tracks, refresher/renewal rules, this site's relationship to OSHA and hazwoper-osha.com, and certificates/SCORM-LMS formats.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hazwoperosha.org/privacy-policy/) / [Terms of Use](https://hazwoperosha.org/terms-of-use/): Site legal pages.
